filterSummary: Successfully selected 4 English and 3 Arabic videos. Coverage was strong for LU-Decomposition and SVD in both languages. English coverage for Power Method and PageRank was also good. Arabic coverage was challenging; no relevant videos were found for The Power Method or PageRank due to ambiguous search terms and lack of content. For the 'Comparison of Methods' topic, no English video passed the gates, while a specific Arabic video comparing iterative methods was found and selected under the view count exception rule.
